ValidationRule.description: [INC0169766] When the picklist value for field Tanium Infrastructure Required is Yes – Tanium as a Service, Duration days must fall between 1 - 90 for promotion = ITSC
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(Duration__c < 1, Duration__c > 90), ISPICKVAL( Tanium_Infrastructure__c , "Yes – Tanium as a Service"), (ISPICKVAL(Promotion__c , "ITSC")))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Promotion = ITSC, duration days must fall between 1 - 90 when Tanium Infrastructure Required selection is "Yes - Tanium as a Service".
